llm_response.reason: The website burton.co.at mimics the well-known Burton brand but is not the official domain. It features ambiguous company information, lack of legal/regional registration, generic about/privacy content, SSL and certificate issues, and heavy use of psychological trust triggers (free shipping, fast responses, 24/7 support). There are no verifiable or appropriate business contact details. Multiple characteristics match typical scam online shops, including use of urgency, unrealistic offers, and lack of transparency.
